package.name: Virtual Phone
package.description: Adds persistent in-story phones for personas and configured characters, with Engine-backed calls, apps, notifications, and a polished docked device shell. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents, then open the phone from the chat toolbar.
